headline: Ghar ka khana, fast aur tasty. Daily cooking made effortless.
bio: Hey, main Ananya! Working professionals aur beginners ke liye simple Indian vegetarian recipes share karti hoon, jisse kitchen mein ghanton spend na karna pade.

products.title: 15-Minute Meal Prep Guide
products.tierReason: A quick digital guide offering immediate utility, ideal as an entry-level purchase for new followers.
products.summary: Busy weekdays ke liye super-fast vegetarian meal plans aur recipes.
products.description: Agar office ke baad cooking bohot exhausting lagti hai, toh yeh PDF guide aapke liye hai. Isme milenge quick meal prep routines, smart hacks, aur easy dinner ideas jo 15-20 minute mein tayar ho jaayein.
whatYouGet: PDF Guide with 25 fast Indian recipes

products.title: Master Everyday Cooking Workshop
products.tierReason: A comprehensive live session providing interactive learning without requiring long-term commitment.
products.summary: 2 ghante mein seekho Indian vegetarian cooking ke core secrets.
products.description: Beginners ke liye interactive live class jahan hum seekhenge basic masale balances, quick gravy bases, aur kitchen time management tricks taaki roz ka khana stress-free ban sake.
whatYouGet: Q&A session to answer your kitchen doubts

products.title: 1-on-1 Kitchen Setup & Diet Call
products.tierReason: Direct access to the creator's time to build a custom routine warrants a premium tier.
